C0380.title: Credential Stuffing Gang Steals 12,900 Accounts, Involving Nearly 10 Million Yuan
C0380.summary: Yancheng police cracked a credential stuffing case where suspects repeatedly attempted logins on a major e-commerce platform using home broadband addresses, successfully stealing 12,900 accounts with an involved amount of nearly 10 million yuan. The case is under further investigation.
